# Vendored

| File | From | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `abcjs-basic-min.js` | [abcjs](https://github.com/paulrosen/abcjs) (`abcjs`, `dist/`) | 6.7.2 | MIT, in `abcjs_basic.LICENSE` |

Served as-is into the preview frame to draw and play ```` ```music ```` fences.
Its notes come from abcjs's sound fonts, through reader's server (`src/soundfont.js`).
To update, copy the same file from a newer `abcjs` and change the version here.
